falseSynonyms.zh: 勝出不等於 compete win 是競爭結果；compete 只表示參與競爭，未必勝出。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON To compete is to take part; to win is to succeed.

falseSynonyms.zh: 打鬥／爭鬥不等於所有 compete fight 可指身體衝突或激烈鬥爭；正常商業或體育競爭不一定是 fight。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Competition can be peaceful and rule-based; fighting implies conflict.

falseSynonyms.zh: 參賽／玩不等於 compete play 可指進行某項運動，但沒有必然『爭勝』含義。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON You can play without competing.

falseSynonyms.zh: 參與不等於競爭 participate 只表示參加；活動可以完全沒有競爭性。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Participation does not necessarily involve rivalry.

falseSynonyms.zh: 反對不等於 compete oppose 是反對某人／政策／提議；compete 是為同一目標或優勢而競爭。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Opposition is not necessarily competition.

falseSynonyms.zh: 比較不等於 compete compare 是找相同與不同；compete 是試圖勝過或取得有限資源。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Comparing evaluates differences; competing seeks advantage or victory.

falseSynonyms.zh: 表現不等於 compete perform 指表現或演出；有人可以表現很好卻沒有參與競賽。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Performance can occur without competition.

falseSynonyms.zh: contest 作動詞可表示『質疑／爭辯』，也可表示爭奪，語義要小心 contest a decision 常是質疑；contest a seat 才可表示競逐。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Contest has multiple senses, so its object determines whether it means compete.
